card.name: Scattered words before a noun
card.fires_on: No shared pattern. It fires on unrelated words such as a number, an article, an adjective or a modifier, each just before a following noun or term.

modes.label: Article before a noun
modes.description: The word a comes just before a described thing or name.
modes.example: This curve is known as<< a>> kyphotic curve.

modes.label: Modifier before a noun
modes.description: An adjective or adverb sits just before the term it modifies.

card.plain: It has no clear pattern. It responds to assorted words that come just before another word.
